races.display_title: Molson Coors Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Not a strong handicap chase on paper and MALINAS GLORY could be the way to go as he looks on a good mark having been first past the post in a hunter here when last seen in the spring. Saint Arion makes a quick switch to fences for his in-form stable and may have found a good opening if leaving his previous form behind in first-time cheekpieces. races.display_title: WTW Willis Towers Watson Handicap
races.verdict: Perhaps this is the day APACHE OUTLAW finally snaps his losing run. Like the selection, Mercurial hasn't tasted success since 2024 but he's recorded 2 good placed efforts in his last 3 starts. Last year's winner Dragon of Malta is once again bidding for successive victories, and a third in this race in 4 years, having scored here on Monday. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE) MERCURIAL (IRE) DRAGON OF MALTA (IRE)

races.display_title: Edmund & Josie Whelan Memorial Listowel Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: JAGGED EDGE might be able to give the weight away and land a second successive listed win. Meriden is another who has already won at listed level this season and is second choice ahead of Chica Guerrera , who has been performing well enough in handicaps to think she can make an impact at this higher level. JAGGED EDGE (IRE) MERIDEN CHICA GUERRERA (IRE)

races.display_title: Jet, Peggy & Eamonn O'Carroll Memorial Handicap
races.verdict: An interesting 3-y-o handicap to conclude the card with the vote going to top weight COUNT BEZUKHOV , who has some solid form and there may well be even more to come now that his stamina is drawn out further. Sunrush is unexposed at the trip and can go well again, with Huff'n'puff completing the shortlist. COUNT BEZUKHOV (IRE) SUNRUSH (IRE) HUFF'N'PUFF
